title: PR #233: CodeQL: enable manual baseline analysis on main
content:
State: open
Merged: False
Draft: True

## Purpose

Add `workflow_dispatch` to the existing CodeQL workflow so maintainers can explicitly run the current default-branch analysis after bot-authored commits, when push-triggered workflows may not have run.

## Scope
- One workflow trigger addition in `.github/workflows/codeql.yml`.
- No permission changes, no changes to languages/categories, no `continue-on-error`, and no security-gate bypass.
- This does not itself restore the CodeQL baseline until the change is reviewed/merged and a successful workflow run is triggered on `main`.

## Evidence / acceptance
- Verify CodeQL Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, and Rust jobs all complete successfully on the current `main` SHA after dispatch.
- Recheck PR #232 code-scanning configuration comparison after that run.
- Do not merge PR #232 or claim `VERIFIED` until all required checks and baseline warning are resolved.
